estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 35 lines with 6 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 192 MB, CPU: 240m.

warnings.message: Avoid use of cache directory with pip. Use `pip install --no-cache-dir <package>`
Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`
`COPY --from` should reference a previously defined `FROM` alias

suggestions.message: Use the `--no-cache` switch to avoid the need to use `--update` and remove `/var/cache/apk/*` when done installing packages

securityIssues.suggestion: Review principle of least privilege and immutable tags.

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
